name: Stop Stress Loop
desc: 中止所有 stress 循環: 取消排定的重開機/關機（shutdown /a）、清計數檔、清 RunOnce 自動重跑註冊。要放棄測試時把它做成單獨一個任務。
raw: for /f "tokens=1" %%V in ('reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce" 2^>nul ^| findstr /r /c:"^[ ]*SE_"') do reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce" /v %%V /f >nul 2>&1
echo %C_INFO%[INFO] Stress counters and reboot RunOnce entries cleared.%C_END%
